search_intent: Informational guidance on what to clarify before commissioning brand design.
target_buyer: Accomplished women entrepreneurs preparing a brand redesign
distinct_point_of_view: Clarify audience, positioning, offer and proof before briefing a designer.
direct_answer_requirement: Brand strategy before design clarifies who you serve, what you want to be known for, and why someone should choose you. Those decisions give your visual identity a clear job to do.

required_questions.question: Why should brand strategy come before design?
How do you know if an agency prioritizes brand strategy before design?

required_concepts.concept: Measure inquiry quality and offer understanding
Support the promise with experience, results and testimonials

claims.claim: 70% of B2B participants use AI tools during vendor selection.
claims.source_title: 2026 B2B Buyer Journey: The Power of AI and Trusted Relationships
claims.decision_reason: Original report and methodology reviewed; wording identifies participants rather than all buyers.
claims.supporting_excerpt: 70% of participants leverage AI in their vendor selection process
claims.limitation: 288 US B2B decision-makers; nonprobability purposive unweighted online sample, May 20–June 1, 2026. Does not establish that vague messaging always causes exclusion.

claims.claim: Dash.app reports 68% of companies connect brand consistency with revenue growth.
claims.source_title: Branding statistics you need to know in 2026
claims.decision_reason: Jake explicitly requested retention of the Dash statistic with attribution; not represented as primary research.
claims.exception_approval_note: User: “This is what the statistic says for dash app so you can use it.” Existing evidence/approval-scope.json confirms 68% retained with Dash attribution.
claims.limitation: Secondary roundup links to MarketingLTB; original study and causality not independently verified.
claims.supporting_excerpt: 68% of companies say brand consistency adds 10–20% to revenue growth

claims.claim: Crowned Authority Assessment evaluates Clarity, Identity, Structure, Voice and Visibility.
claims.decision_reason: Live official assessment page confirms the five areas.

forbidden_claims: Do not imply the Ipsos sample represents all B2B buyers.
Do not identify Dash as the original research or independently established causation.
Do not invent RadarKit metrics or guarantee business outcomes.
approved_by: Codex reconciliation of Jake’s selected article and approved direction
